newsitem.title: USA: Forensic sees results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Forensic sees results below expectations.

text.p: Forensic Technologies International Corp said Thursday it estimates net income for the fourth quarter and all of 1996 will be lower than the net income projected by industry analysts.

Calling 1996 "an outstanding year," chief executive Jack Dunn said "The company will achieve record revenue and net income for the year despite a fourth quarter in which our net income fell short of analysts' expectations."

The company said its performance in the fourth quarter was affected by the expense of integration and the delay in achievement of anticipated results of the two acquisitions completed at the beginning of the quarter.

Additionally, Forensic said, lower profits from the operations in some offices, coupled with timing delays during the December holidays of several larger, in-progress cases, further detracted from this quarter's results.
The company said it expects to announce its fourth quarter and 1996 full year results by mid-February.
